content:
I encountered an error while submitting my app to the App Store. Please analyze this error and help me fix it.

<error_logs>
{
  "message": "This Apple Account has been locked for security reasons. Visit iForgot to reset your account (https://iforgot.apple.com).",
  "appleAuth": {
    "phase": "signin-complete",
    "status": 403,
    "serviceErrors": [
      {
        "code": "-20209",
        "message": "This Apple Account has been locked for security reasons. Visit iForgot to reset your account (https://iforgot.apple.com)."
      }
    ]
  }
}
</error_logs>

<instructions>
- If this error is related to my app's code (e.g., build errors, code issues, configuration problems in the codebase), please try to fix it.
- If this error is related to App Store Connect resources (e.g., provisioning profiles, certificates, bundle IDs, signing issues), use your App Store Connect tools to resolve it directly. For example:
  - Duplicate or conflicting provisioning profiles → list profiles with `asc profiles list`, delete the duplicates, and retry the submission
  - Missing or expired certificates → list and diagnose with `asc certificates list`
  - Bundle ID conflicts → check with `asc bundle-ids list`
  Remember to call `setupAsc` first before running any `asc` commands. Do NOT just tell the user to go to the App Store Connect website — use your tools to fix it.
- If this error is NOT related to my code or App Store Connect resources (e.g., network outages, infrastructure failures, third-party service errors), please:
  1. Explain what likely caused this error
  2. Suggest specific actions I can take to resolve it
  3. Do NOT attempt to modify any code files
- If you're unsure about the cause or the solution seems complex, please advise me to contact the support team for further assistance.
</instructions>
